backup.title: Back up your library
backup.description: Download your favorites, queue, listening history and playback preferences. Restore from a JSON backup up to 2 MB. No sign-in required; the file stays on your device.
backup.exportFailed: Could not create the backup. Your library has not been changed.
backup.invalidJson: This file is not valid JSON.
backup.unsupportedVersion: This backup version is not supported.
backup.invalidData: This is not a valid Dumb and Dahmer library backup. Check its fields, episode IDs and numbers.
backup.tooLarge: The backup is too large. Choose a file up to 2 MB.
backup.readFailed: Could not read that file. Choose it again.
backup.unavailable: {{count}} saved episodes are not in the current catalog. Their IDs and history will be retained for future catalog updates.
backup.mergePolicy: Favorites are combined. Your queue keeps its order, with new entries appended. More recent progress wins; local progress wins ties. Completed history is kept and listening time uses the larger total, avoiding double-counting.
backup.replacePolicy: Replace favorites, queue, listening records and the selected episode with this backup. Anything absent from the backup will be removed from your local library.
backup.pauseNotice: Applying pauses playback and clears the sleep timer. Nothing plays automatically.
backup.preferencesSeparate: Speed and volume stay unchanged during import. After a successful restore you can apply each backup preference separately.
backup.confirmReplace: I understand that replacement removes my current library data that is not in this backup.
backup.restoreFailed: The restore could not be saved. Your existing library is unchanged. Try again.
backup.concurrentChange: Another tab changed the saved library. Reload this page before trying again.
backup.restoredPlayerError: Library restored. Reload the page to restore the paused player.
backup.preferenceFailed: That preference could not be saved. Its current value is unchanged.
